title: Cross-Platform Attribution Modeling, Incrementality & Media Mix
overview: Cross-platform attribution reconciles overlapping conversion credit across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and TikTok Ads using multi-touch modeling, incrementality experiments, and Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM).
coreConcepts: Attribution overlap: multiple walled gardens claiming credit for the exact same transaction
First-Click vs. Last-Click vs. Data-Driven Attribution (DDA) modeling
Incrementality testing (geo-holdouts and matched-market experiments) measuring lift over baseline
Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM / Robyn / Meridian) estimating macro media efficiency without user tracking
features: Unified cross-channel tracking reconciliation engine comparing self-reported vs. GA4 modeled data
Blended CAC and Blended ROAS (Marketing Efficiency Ratio - MER) calculations
Touchpoint timeline reconstruction mapping user journeys across social discovery and search capture
Post-Purchase Surveys (PPS / Fairing / Kno) providing zero-party attribution validation
bestPractices: Never sum self-reported conversions from Google, Meta, and TikTok directly (leads to 30-50% overcounting)
Use Marketing Efficiency Ratio (MER = Total Revenue / Total Ad Spend) as the North Star executive KPI
Assign funnel roles: TikTok & Meta for demand generation, Google Search/Shopping for demand capture
Run quarterly geo-lift holdout tests to calculate platform-specific incrementality multipliers
policies: Compliance with platform API usage policies regarding cross-platform user profile stitching
Adherence to GDPR and CCPA restrictions on cross-site user identification
Data aggregation thresholds to protect end-user privacy
limitations: Walled gardens do not share impression-level click IDs or raw user graphs with each other
iOS 14.5+ Private Click Measurement and App Tracking Transparency restricts cross-app tracking
View-through conversions have differing lookback windows (1 day on Meta vs. 1-3 days on Google/TikTok)
commonIssues: Meta and Google both claiming 100% credit for the same high-value purchase order
Over-allocating budget to branded search due to last-click attribution bias
Undervaluing top-of-funnel TikTok and Meta Reels due to delayed purchase conversion paths

troubleshootingGuide.issue: Severe discrepancy between platform totals and actual bank revenue
troubleshootingGuide.resolution: Implement GA4 Data-Driven Attribution combined with post-purchase survey zero-party validation

troubleshootingGuide.issue: Brand search capturing credit for social media discoveries
troubleshootingGuide.resolution: Test pausing or reducing Brand Search budget by 20% to observe if overall revenue drops (incrementality test)
